```{r residual-plots-2, echo=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=9, fig.align="center", fig.pos="H"}
residuals_fit <- residuals(fit)
predictors <- list(
  "YouTube Views"  = clean_data$YouTube.Views,
  "YouTube Likes"  = clean_data$YouTube.Likes,
  "TikTok Posts"   = clean_data$TikTok.Posts,
  "TikTok Likes"   = clean_data$TikTok.Likes,
  "TikTok Views"   = clean_data$TikTok.Views
)

par(mfrow = c(2, 3))

for (name in names(predictors)) {
  x <- predictors[[name]]
  plot(
    x, residuals_fit,
    main  = paste("Residuals vs\n", name),
    xlab  = name,
    ylab  = "Residuals",
    pch   = 20,
    cex   = 0.5,
    col   = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.3)
  )
  abline(h = 0, col = "gray", lwd = 1, lty = 2)
  lines(lowess(x, residuals_fit), col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
}

hist(
  residuals_fit,
  breaks = 50,
  main   = "Histogram of Residuals",
  xlab   = "Residuals",
  col    = "lightgray",
  border = "white"
)
abline(v = 0, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
```
